faq.title: Everything you need to know about Gantra
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about the platform, how it works, and its technical features.

questions.q1: What is Gantra and what is its purpose?
questions.a1: Gantra is an Algerian platform specialized in monitoring and analyzing sentiment in the digital space. It collects posts and comments related to your brand from social media and news sources, then analyzes them using AI models specifically trained on Algerian dialect to give you an accurate understanding of what your audience is saying.
questions.a2: Gantra currently supports: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, X (Twitter), Google News, and RSS feeds. The platform continuously expands its list of sources to cover as much Algerian digital content as possible.
questions.q3: How does the platform handle Algerian dialect and Arabizi?
questions.a3: Gantra relies on two specialized models: DziriBERT and MARBERT, both trained on real Algerian Arabic data including dialect, Arabizi, and Arabic-French mixed content. This gives the platform a high ability to understand local context compared to general solutions.
questions.a4: Company administrators can create custom alert rules such as: alert when negative sentiment exceeds 40%, or when a keyword appears more than 50 times per day. These alerts are triggered automatically after each monitoring run and reach users inside the platform instantly.
questions.q5: Who can access data within the company?
questions.a5: The platform uses a role-based access control system. Administrators have full access including settings, team management, surveys, and triggering monitoring. Analysts have read-only access to data and reports without the ability to modify settings or invite new members.
questions.q6: What are surveys and how do they work?
questions.a6: Gantra allows you to create custom surveys and send them to customers via a direct link or QR code. You can add different types of questions such as NPS scale, satisfaction ratings, and open-ended questions. Text answers are automatically analyzed and classified by sentiment without any manual intervention.
questions.q7: Do you need technical expertise to use the platform?
questions.a7: No, Gantra is designed to be easy to use for all team members regardless of their technical background. The user interface is clear and simple, and the monitoring and data collection process works automatically. The administrator only needs to add keywords and social media accounts once.
